thread:
alex: Heads-up — starting planning to deprecate the legacy attribution v1 event shape. Need an interop + deprecation plan and SLO impact analysis. @mira can you drive?

mira: Yep, I'll own this. I sketched a proposal: adapter shim in ingest + dual-write window for 3 months, plus migration tooling. Will share draft soon.

jon: Adapter shim = runtime mapping in the ingest path? that could add cpu + p99. we should measure.

alex: Correct — runtime shim as transitional only. Long-term we want producers to emit the v2 canonical shape. Also planning a CLI migration tool for customers.

sam: We need numbers. +1 to migration tool. Can infra quantify the shim p99 overhead in a small canary?

mira: Draft items i have: timeline, compatibility matrix, fallback rules, reconciler/backfill plan. Key risk is billing reconciliation if fingerprint semantics change between formats.

teja: Strongly +1 to preserving audit provenance. We need a fingerprint mapping table so backfills don't reassign credits incorrectly.

infra-bot: deploybot: canary rollout scheduled for 2024-11-03 02:00 UTC — tagging infra for perf measurements.

jon: quick pseudocode for shim mapping (example):
```
// ingest_shim.js (pseudo)
const mapV1toV2 = (evt) => ({
  request_id: evt.rid,
  tenant_id: evt.account,
  token_count: evt.tokens || evt.token_count,
  fingerprint: hash(evt.client_ts + evt.user_id + evt.seq),
  provenance: { source: 'v1-ingest-shim', original: evt }
});
```

mira: For the reconciler/backfill approach i propose: keep raw v1 events in cold storage for 6 months; run backfill jobs that canonicalize and emit v2 events into the ledger (tagged as backfill) so audits can trace original events.

alex: SLO implications — during dual-write we will likely see duplicate credits surface. Proposal: idempotency key = request_id + event_hash at ledger ingestion and de-dupe window of 24h.

sam: Operational playbook: alert if duplicate credits exceed 0.1% over a 1h window or if reconciliation drift > 0.5% over 24h. Also require runbook for manual claim repair.

mira: Question for infra: can we surface a migration progress API per-tenant so support & customers can watch status?

teja: Also think about deprecation window: enterprise customers asked for 180 days. Can we compromise at 120 days with an opt-in 180d for big tenants?

alex: 120 days seems reasonable operationally; add expedited migration support for large tenants (opt-in 180d). @mira add migration API + sample scripts to the checklist. Also coordinate with support and account teams.

mira: Will do. I'll publish RFC follow-up doc + checklist tomorrow and include sample CLI, migration API, and replay/backfill instructions.

jon: LGTM — let's schedule a 30-min sync next Tue to walk timeline and assign owners.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll start a perf canary ticket and tag infra and eng-sre.

teja: :eyes: will prepare fingerprint mapping schema.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll loop in legal/compliance for retention/privacy checks re: raw event cold storage.

mira: Adding action items now: 1) publish RFC follow-up doc, 2) add migration API + sample scripts, 3) perf canary for shim, 4) backfill plan & runbooks, 5) deprecation timeline + customer comms.

alex: Nice. Closing thread when doc is live.
